author: Ari Koslow
title: Cam Schlittler will not pitch in All-Star game
desc: Cam Schlittler will not pitch in the All-Star game.
impact: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Schlittler is healthy, but he made the decision not to pitch next week. He didn't want to push himself on what would be his between-starts throw day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: JR Ritchie to pitch in bulk relief role Sunday
desc: JR Ritchie will pitch in a bulk relief role on Sunday against the Cardinals.
impact: Danny Young will open for the Braves with Ritchie following him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Danny Young to serve as opener Sunday
desc: Danny Young will open on Sunday for the Braves against the Cardinals.
impact: Young will take the mound to open Sunday's series finale. JR Ritchie will follow him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jack Anderson optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Twins optioned RHP Jack Anderson to Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Anderson was claimed off of waivers from the Red Sox on Saturday. He will report to Triple-A for Minnesota.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jared Oliva released by Mets
desc: The Mets released OF Jared Oliva.
impact: Oliva had been designated for assignment on Thursday and passed through waivers unclaimed. He will figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Coleman Crow activated from IL, optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Brewers activated RHP Coleman Crow from the 15-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Nashville.
impact: Crow missed the last month due to a flexor strain in his right elbow. He will remain in Triple-A for now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Woodruff transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Brewers transferred RHP Brandon Woodruff to the 60-day injured list.
impact: The move opens up a spot on the 40-man roster for Milwaukee. Woodruff recently went for a second opinion on his injury.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Braden Shewmake traded to Brewers
desc: The Brewers acquired INF Braden Shewmake from the Astros for cash considerations.
impact: Shewmake had been designated for assignment by the Astros on Friday. He will add infield depth for Milwaukee.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Greg Jones designated for assignment
desc: The Brewers designated OF Greg Jones for assignment.
impact: Jones loses his spot on the 40-man roster for Milwaukee. He will head to waivers as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: David Hamilton (hamstring) expected to miss 'couple of series' after break
desc: David Hamilton will miss " a couple series" after the All-Star break.
impact: Hamilton was placed on the injured list earlier this week. He will likely be sidelined through close to the end of July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Misiorowski to likely resume throwing Tuesday
desc: Jacob Misiorowski will likely begin throwing again Tuesday.
impact: Misiorowski was scratched from his scheduled start on Sunday. He is not expected to pitch in the first series out of the All-Star break for Milwaukee.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Miles Mikolas blanks Yankees early, but Nats bullpen cracks
desc: Miles Mikolas allowed zero earned runs on four hits and one walk over four innings in Saturday's loss to the Yankees.
impact: After the outing, he now owns a 5.53 ERA and 1.33 WHIP with a 3-7 record through 20 games. Mikolas will likely continue to operate behind an opener in the second half of the season.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Curtis Mead Homers in Loss to Yankees
desc: Curtis Mead went 2-for-3 in loss to the Yankees with a home run, one run scored, one RBI and a walk.
impact: After Saturday's loss, Mead is batting .245 with 16 home runs, 43 RBI, 41 runs scored, and five stolen bases across 79 games. Mead is hitting .393 with four RBI and three runs scored over his last seven games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: James Wood keeps raking, but Nats come up short
desc: James Wood went 3-for-5 in loss to the Yankees with a home run, one run scored and one RBI.
impact: After Saturday's loss, Wood is batting .278 with 27 home runs, 63 RBI, 88 runs scored and 15 stolen bases across 96 games. Wood has been on fire at the plate, going 10-for-23 with five home runs and eight RBI over his last seven games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Kyle Bradish picks up the win as O's cruise past Royals
desc: Kyle Bradish allowed one earned run on two hits and two walks while striking out five over 6.2 innings in Saturday's win over the Royals.
impact: After the victory, he now owns a 3.61 ERA and 1.35 WHIP with a 6-9 record across 19 starts. Bradish carried a no-hitter into the seventh inning and look dominant for the majority of the game. The Orioles will hope the 29-year-old can come out of the All-Star break pitching as well as he did Saturday.
